BillHeading.BriefDescription: Preserving coverage of preventative services without cost sharing.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preserving coverage of preventative services without cost sharing; and amending RCW 48.43.047.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 48.43.047 and 2018 c 14 s 1 are each amended to read as follows:Health plans—Minimum coverage for preventative services—No cost-sharing requirements.
BillSection.P: (1) A health plan issued on or after June 7, 2018, must, at a minimum, provide coverage for the same preventive services required to be covered under 42 U.S.C. Sec. 300gg-13 (2016) (2022) and any federal rules or guidance in effect on December January 31, 2016 2023, implementing 42 U.S.C. Sec. 300gg-13.
(2) The health plan may not impose cost-sharing requirements for the preventive services required to be covered under subsection (1) of this section.

(3) The insurance commissioner shall enforce this section consistent with federal rules, guidance, and case law in effect on December January 31, 2016 2023, applicable to 42 U.S.C. 300gg-13 (2016) (2022).
